pr_title: Implement progress bar for `gh release download`

issue_context.title: gh release download could use a progress meter
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/cli/cli/discussions/3285
Originally posted by **smowton** March 23, 2021 Used `gh release download` to fetch a release binary for the first time. A few comments: * The eight-dot single-character progress spinner is really small; it took me 10 seconds or so to notice it was doing anything. * The spinner is printed aqua-blue even when my terminal has a white background, which is nearly invisible. Perhaps just standard text colour would be better? * Since we're downloading a file and likely know its size pretty early, a CURL-style progress meter would be better than making me open `nettop` to figure out if the command has stalled or not.

review_comments: What do you think about adding in a call at the end of this function to `io.StopProgressIndicator()`? I don't necessarily like how this code relies on the calling function to stop the progress indicator. Right now it is only being invoked from one place but that is not a guarantee for the future.
I think that makes sense. I added a call to `io.StopProgressIndicator()` after each asset is downloaded, let me know if you had something different in mind
